body:
A long awaited substance to get. The aniticipation was great. Me and my friend R. Had been waiting to get this for about 3 months. When we finally got it we each consumed 1000mg of vitamin C. Being my 3rd time doing it and my friend R's first we poured the powder onto 2 peanut butter crackers and ate them. The onset was so long...about 30 to 40 minutes. I diddnt realize I was tripping till I realized I had no since of time. I looked at the clock and it had only been about 5min. But it seemed like and hour! It was crazy I've never really had such a skewed since of time. Then my friend went to go throw up and makeing him leave the room so I could keep my own stomach from upchucking this lovely substance. While he was gone I put on a sublime CD and began to stare at the floor. Then when the music kicked in so did the hallucinations...
I was stareing at awe at the carpet as the fibers seemed to texturize and wave at me. Then I noticed letters...everywhere... There were letters like alphabet soup all over the floor, in the carpet, the paint of the walls ,the ceiling, but nothing else. Then when my friend retured we jus sat and listend to sublime the whole trip and converstated about nothing. My mind couldn't think of anything that didn't connect with my deep emotions it was like a trance and not a trip.
it was like a trance and not a trip.
But then I stared at the palm of my hand and it seemed as if my hand had turned to bone and all my colors were skewed. Everything I looked at was not its normal color. But none the less I had no idea how my friend was feeling. I was guessing the same as he couldnt seem to take his eyes of the bottom of the bedroom door. Then he said after what seemed an hour 'the door in eating the carpet.'  and the rest of the trip was about 4 more hours and it was in complete silence with the music blareing and then when I could finaly fall asleep the room seemed to engulf me in my bed. Like the world breathed when I did, explainable experience but definatly worth it agian and again and again.
